chapter.title: Start-up
chapter.para: These requirements cover what the hypervisor does from the moment that a boot loader or the firmware hands over the computer to the moment that the VMs run.

section.para: The hypervisor shall start on x86_64 when it is loaded by a Multiboot boot loader on a processor with AMD SVM and nested paging, and on arm64 when it is entered at exception level 2 on a processor with the virtualization extensions and a GICv2 with the virtualization extensions.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the processors on which a hypervisor of this kind can run, and the ways in which QEMU, the target, starts it.

section.para: The hypervisor shall compute the CRC-32 of its own image when it starts, after it has set up its console (on arm64 also its MMU, from the device tree), and before it checks the processor or sets up a VM.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A corrupted image of the hypervisor must not run the VMs, whose isolation it provides.

section.para: The hypervisor shall compare the CRC-32 of its image with the one stored in the image when it was linked and, if they differ, print both on its console and halt, with no VM and no other CPU started.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A corrupted image of the hypervisor must not run the VMs, whose isolation it provides.

section.para: The hypervisor shall check that the processor has the features that it needs: SVM with nested paging not disabled by the firmware on x86_64, and a GICv2 with the virtualization extensions on arm64.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A hypervisor that cannot run guests must say why.

section.para: The hypervisor shall stop with a message that names the missing feature if the processor does not have the features that it needs.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A hypervisor that cannot run guests must say why.

section.para: The hypervisor shall stop with a message if the information that it needs about the computer is missing or wrong: the size of the RAM, the list of the CPUs, the description of the interrupt controller or of the serial ports, or if a CPU that it starts does not come online.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The hypervisor cannot guess a configuration of the computer.

section.para: The hypervisor shall make its checks, then set up the memory of the VMs, then start the other CPUs, and then run its own vCPU on the CPU that started it.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: No guest may run on a computer that was not checked.

section.para: The hypervisor shall run no VM before its checks are complete.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: No guest may run on a computer that was not checked.

section.para: The hypervisor shall report on its console, when it starts, the number of its VMs and CPUs, the result of the check of its image, the memory and timers that it found, and for each VM its memory, CPUs, console port and GDB port.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: The report is what an operator sees of the configuration that runs.
